ana_cs: Hey team — CrescentAI renewal (120 seats) hitting two blocks: pricing reconciliation (they want the 9mo term discount) and procurement needs a vendor_code change before issuing the PO. Also legal is asking to add KMS clause to the SOW. Can we triage?
ben_sales: Thanks Ana. Do we have the updated quote with the 9mo term applied? I thought pricing team sent a one-off discount.
lena_finance: I have the draft invoice but vendor_code is currently VEND-OLD-334. Procurement insists on VEND-CRES-992. If procurement sends a PO with wrong code our billing automation will reject it.
kevin_legal: @ana_cs @ben_sales I reviewed the contract: adding the KMS clause is fine but it requires acceptance from security and will need an updated SOW. That will push docs by ~24-48h unless we do an addendum.
mira_enablement: Can we defer enablement kickoff until signature? They want kickoff next week. We can do limited onboarding without full contract but want clarity on scope.
nana_cs_note: sorry typo above — meant @mira_enablement.
ben_sales: Action plan proposal: 1) Sales approves 9mo discount on the quote 2) Finance updates invoice with VEND-CRES-992 3) Legal prepares KMS addendum and we attach to DocuSign 4) Procurement issues PO matching updated invoice 5) Send DocuSign to signer list. Thoughts? :+1:
lena_finance: That works. I can update invoice today if pricing confirms. Will flag to billing ops to accept VEND-CRES-992.
kevin_legal: I'll draft a short KMS addendum template and drop it in here in a bit. If CrescentAI signs the addendum + SOW we should be covered.
ben_sales: CrescentAI budget owner wants net-30 on the 9mo term. We previously quoted net-45. Any blockers?
lena_finance: Net-30 requires approval from revenue ops for this customer tier. I'll loop @revenue-ops but we can ask for a one-time exception.
ben_sales: I'll nudge the buyer and ask for expedited PO once vendor code updated.
docu-sign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE12345 — status: draft (waiting for attachment).
kevin_legal: Attached addendum (draft):
```
Addendum: KMS key management clause
Customer will manage encryption keys via customer-managed KMS. Redwood Inference will not access customer-managed keys and will store key identifiers in audit logs. Changes subject to mutual acceptance.
```
mira_enablement: If procurement can confirm PO date and signature by EOD tomorrow we can still start orientation next Tuesday with read-only access.
nana_cs_note2: again typo, that's me (ana_cs) — apologies.
ben_sales: Quick check: signer list? Last we had CFO + Head of Procurement. Is that still correct?
lena_finance: Procurement (procurement@crescentai.com) + CFO (cfo@crescentai.com). If they delegate we need the delegate's email in the PO.
kevin_legal: Recommend sending DocuSign to procurement first, then CFO. That way PO and addendum attach in order.
ben_sales: I'll prepare the envelope after Lena confirms invoice update.
lena_finance: Invoice updated, PO code changed to VEND-CRES-992, invoice number INV-2026-87421. Please ask buyer to include PO: PO-87421-CA in the doc.
ben_sales: Noted. @kevin_legal please attach addendum + SOW, then I'll route to CrescentAI.
kevin_legal: Will do now.
docu-sign-bot: DocuSign envelope updated: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE12345 — status: sent to procurement@crescentai.com at 2026-03-23T15:12:30Z.
mira_enablement: Great — I'll tentatively reserve onboarding slot for Tue 16:00 PT pending signature.
nana_cs_closure: Thanks all — recap: Lena updated invoice/invoice # INV-2026-87421 and vendor code, Kevin added KMS addendum, Ben to route DocuSign to procurement, Mira reserved onboarding. If procurement sends PO with PO-87421-CA we can finalize. Will follow up if any delays. :green_heart:
